scheme_name: Subsidy for Asset Creation for Intellectual Property: Patent Registration
other_conditions: Enterprise must be a micro, small, or medium manufacturing enterprise
Enterprise can be new or existing
Enterprise must be located in Tamil Nadu
No documents are required to claim the reimbursement
Application must be filed within 6 months of obtaining the patent, trademark, or geographical indication
benefits_summary: 75% subsidy on patent filing costs up to ₹3,00,000 per patent (maximum reimbursement ₹1,00,000).
